description: Resolves a regulatory citation (e.g. '4000.1 II.A.8.d', 'B3-4.3-04', 'Freddie Mac Guide 5306.1', '38 U.S.C. 3737', 'M26-7 Chapter 4 Topic 9', 'SBA Notice 5000-872764', 'SOP 50 10 8 B.Ch1.A.2', 'HB-1-3555 11.3') to a `register_id`. Errors: `not_found` (the cite parses but is not in the corpus; `parsed` shows the parse), `ambiguous` (it could mean several registers, listed in `candidates`; no guess is made), `unparsed` (not recognizable as a citation). Near matches are not suggested. A handbook section resolves to the handbook's own register; documents that cite or amend it (e.g. Mortgagee Letters) are listed in `related` and are not the section's text. Identical copies of a section resolve to one register and are listed in `also_at`. A whole-handbook name returns `handbook`, an outline of its parts.
name: lookup_citation

also_at.description: Identical copies of the section (other register ids).

candidates.description: On ambiguous: the registers the citation could mean.

canonical_id.description: Set when the register is a same-text copy of that register.

error.description: Present only on an error or refusal: not_found, ambiguous, unparsed, empty_terms, unknown_playbook, unknown_reference, offset_out_of_range, daily_capacity_reached.

fallback.description: On daily_capacity_reached: where the full corpus can be downloaded.

guidance.description: On a refusal or empty search: the server's explanation.

handbook.description: When the citation names a whole handbook: its outline.

hint.description: On an error: the server's explanation.

notice.description: Terms notice: research use only, not legal advice.

parsed.description: The parse of the citation ({kind, canonical, ...}).

register_id.description: The register the citation resolves to.

related.description: Documents that cite or amend the section ({register_id, relation}); not its text.

renumbered_from.description: The old register, when the section was renumbered.

resets.description: On daily_capacity_reached: when capacity resets (00:00 UTC).

superseded_candidates.description: Candidates dropped because a current register replaces them.

superseded_register_id.description: The register holding the prior text of this section.

truncated.description: The candidate scan hit its limit.

title: Look up citation
